page.overview:
Who is Aneé-san?

Aneé-san was a Twi'lek Sith who worked as a bodyguard for Anzellan gangster Que-Dama, wielding a red-bladed lightsaber. known as the Ronin.

Aneé-san appeared in "The Duel: Payback", a non-canon short film directed by Takanobu Mizuno that released as part of the third volume of the Star Wars: Visions series. The animated short, produced by Kamikaze Douga and ANIMA, The character was first introduced at the Star Wars: Visions panel at Celebration Japan on April 19, 2025. The spelling of her name was confirmed in a StarWars.com article published on April 25 of that year. She is voiced by Takako Honda in the original Japanese version and by Suzy Nakamura in the English dub. Concept art of Aneé-san was created by Takashi Okazaki. However, other sources only describe her as a Sith.
